root: ^Ah, Mr. Wade Kim, welcome to the I.M.A. I am Miss Maggie.

Start: ^You are our newest recruit. Big step, joining the I.M.A. We do not take just anyone. You must have impressed someone.

s: ^Thank you. I try my best, so what do i have to know ?.

c-1: ^No time to waste, huh? I like that. But first, we need to see if you have got what it takes.

Briefing: ^Let us get you up to speed. The Information Monitoring Agency (I.M.A.) deals with intelligence, deceptive narratives, and keeping the world from falling apart. It is a big job, and you are now part of it.
^More than that. We track, analyze, and neutralize harmful information before it spreads. And sometimes... well, sometimes we handle things more directly.
Continue: ^Alright, time to see what you are made of. See that arcade machine over there? Go interact with it you will get a code. Then, use the console beside it to input the code. That will send you straight to the training grounds.
^Pass the test, and you are in. Fail… and, well, let us not think about that. Prove yourself, Agent.
